About

Who we are

Classic Reinsurance Brokers is a leading independent reinsurance brokerage firm headquartered in Harare, Zimbabwe. We specialise in providing comprehensive reinsurance broking, advisory, and risk management solutions to insurance companies across Zimbabwe and the broader African market.

Founded on integrity, professionalism, and technical excellence, our team brings decades of combined experience in the insurance and reinsurance industry.

Learn more about us
What we do

Connecting insurers to global reinsurance markets

As an independent reinsurance broker, we give insurance companies access to the capacity, expertise, and terms they need to serve their policyholders with confidence. We facilitate the placement of risk with leading global and regional reinsurers — we do not underwrite risk or assume liability directly.

Reinsurance Broking

We structure and place treaty and facultative reinsurance programmes that optimise risk transfer and capital efficiency. Our deep relationships with leading global and regional reinsurers give insurance companies access to the capacity they need.

Explore

Advisory Services

Strategic risk analysis, market intelligence, and regulatory guidance that help insurance companies optimise their reinsurance programmes, navigate complex requirements, and make informed underwriting decisions.

Explore

Specialty Risk

Nine specialist risk classes covering complex and emerging exposures — from aviation and cyber to political risk and construction — connecting insurers with global specialty reinsurance markets.

Explore

Claims Advocacy

Expert support throughout the reinsurance claims lifecycle — from notification and documentation to negotiation and settlement — ensuring insurers receive the full benefit of their reinsurance protections.
